about.title: Talk to David
paragraphs: Blossom Landscaping LLC is David's landscaping company in Battle Ground, Washington.
From retaining walls and flagstone patios to water features and landscape lighting, every photo on this page is our own work.

services.name: Retaining Walls
services.blurb: Block walls, planters and walls under decks.
services.intro: Retaining walls hold back slopes, create level space and frame planting beds. We build block retaining walls, planters and walls under decks.
photos: Block retaining wall beside a lawn
Curved block wall with river rock and pavers
Block retaining wall below a deck

services.name: Patios & Walkways
services.blurb: Paver and flagstone paths and patios.
services.intro: Paver pathways, flagstone walkways and patios that tie your yard together.
photos: Curved paver walkway and stone planter in a front yard

services.name: Water Features
services.intro: A water feature adds sound and movement to a yard. We build water features with lighting so they look good after dark too.
photos: Rock waterfall water feature beside a patio
Basalt column fountain in river rock
Lit boulder water feature at night

services.name: Landscape Lighting
services.intro: Pathway and landscape lighting makes your yard safer and shows off your work at night.
photos: Paver walkway with landscape lights at night
Stone path lit by path lights at night
Lit stone pillar and walkway at dusk

services.name: Drainage & River Rock
services.blurb: Drainage installs and river rock beds.
services.intro: Drainage installation keeps water where it belongs, and river rock beds finish it off.
photos: Drain and river rock along a fence line
River rock bed along a curved block border

services.name: Lawns, Bark & Yard Care
services.blurb: New lawns, bark dust and yard care.
services.intro: New lawns, fresh bark dust and the yard care that keeps it all looking good, including sprinkler repairs.
